prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate change to a 3D-IC physical design flow.
Hypothesis of the change: c025 (per-net weight cap 15.68) is the strongest robust parent; modestly relaxing the cap by x2 to ~31.36 lets the most timing-critical nets (which drive WNS) retain more weight while keeping the TNS-friendly broad weighting from c021's decay<=0.5 and halved ignore_net_degree, giving a small WNS lift without losing TNS breadth.
Rule-based digest:
total=+0.876 robust(mean-std)=+0.272 min_case=+0.265 all_valid=True
  ariane133-ng45: score=+0.302 dWNS=+42.7% dTNS=+21.9% overflow~149
  bp-ng45: score=+0.309 dWNS=+28.1% dTNS=+33.0% overflow~134
  bp_fe-ng45: score=+0.265 dWNS=+16.0% dTNS=+33.6% overflow~179
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID (failures listed), first say what kind of failure it is (legality / crash / timeout) and whether it looks systematic (all seeds of a case) or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which case/metric moved and plausible mechanism, (3) one concrete next-step suggestion. No preamble.

response: The hypothesis held: all runs valid, robust score +0.272, every case positive. WNS gains are largest on ariane133-ng45 (+42.7%) and bp-ng45 (+28.1%), with TNS also improving (+21.9% to +33.6%), consistent with the mechanism—relaxed cap lets critical nets keep weight while c021's decay/broad weighting preserves TNS breadth. Overflow (~134–179) is modest, so no congestion blowup. Next step: sweep the cap multiplier (1.5x, 2x, 3x) to locate the WNS/TNS sweet spot and confirm 2x isn't leaving gains on the table.
